notes.title: Jurassic Mode
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36262694/241a4e5953f4260ec75b43d6a80845b553c09d5d.png[/img]
Discover the new Jurassic Mode ! Play as a T-Rex, a Raptor, a Brachiosaurus, a Pteranodon or a Triceratops.

New gameplay mechanics have been added with this update. 
You can catch your enemy with the Pteranodon, fly him into the sky and throw him wherever you want.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36262694/660e6cbf6f01e79941ee8a22c6604bf5c328f424.jpg[/img]

Biting the zookeeper with T-Rex

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36262694/a0bd7e3cfd6ca1f8d02eb00234ae2e66d9cc87b7.jpg[/img]

All the possibilities present in the old version of zookeeper simulator are also available for the dinosaur mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36262694/234e022509a30d8d70ac7b5730374ec315b61e8f.jpg[/img]

Don't wait any longer and go mess with the dinosaurs!
